summary: BRBI BR Partners S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a notice to shareholders on interim dividends for Q3 2026. The board approved on November 3, 2026 a payout of R$12,599,484.48, equal to R$0.04 per common or preferred share and R$0.12 per UNIT (BRBI11). Record date is November 12, 2026, ex-dividend trading begins November 13, 2026, and payment is a single installment on November 26, 2026 in Brazilian Reais with no restatement or interest. A routine Brazilian ordinary dividend notification mapped to a US 8-K shareholder notice, it carries no structural overhang or regulatory clock; watch for no risk-arb angle.
